_note: Worker-owned entity colours for run 4, continuing run 3's mapping unchanged (experiments/experiment-3-yga5ws/figures/entity_colors.json). The entities here are the thing the gene table is made of, not the training arm: every arm built on scGPT's own table is scGPT, every arm built on the ESM2 protein table is ESM2, the random-table arm and the shuffled-label draws are the null, and co-expression keeps its colour from runs 2 and 3. Trainable and frozen versions of one entity are separated by marker symbol and opacity, never by colour, so a reader comparing panels across runs 2, 3 and 4 sees the same thing in the same colour.
